chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Imran ibn Abi Aasim, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'There are four whose supplication is not answered for them. One of them is a man who had wealth, so he lent it out without proof. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: "Did I not command you with witnesses?"'
ai.seo_question: Who are the four people whose supplications are not answered according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights that neglecting the prophetic and divine protocol of securing witnesses in financial transactions constitutes a spiritual barrier to the acceptance of supplication. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the interconnection between procedural justice in worldly dealings and spiritual efficacy, linking the specific act of lending to the broader Quranic commandment of documentation found in Surah Al-Baqarah.
